findings.evidence: handlers/payouts.go:91-93 — CreateRefund rejects the request with 400 missing_reason when reason is empty, but the spec's RefundRequest schema lists only [payoutId, amount] as required, so spec-compliant clients omitting reason will be rejected
handlers/misc.go:60 — TestWebhook sets an X-Signature response header (sha256=deadbeef) on the API response, but the spec's 202 response for this operation documents no response headers
